jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Project Manager
is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering localization projects across multiple client accounts. Working under the supervision of a Program Manager, the role ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and at the required quality standards
while maintaining strong client relationships.

The Project Manager acts as a primary client contact
, manages project quotes and workflows, coordinates cross-functional teams (such as Language Delivery, Technical Services, and QA), and oversees project execution from initiation to completion. The role also involves risk management, reporting, process improvements, and supporting account growth
, while ensuring client satisfaction and adherence to internal and ISO standards.

About Transform

At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting-edge language technology, AI-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.

Key Responsibilities

Job Overview

Manage localization projects from quotation through delivery, ensuring deadlines, budgets, and quality standards are met.
Act as the primary point of contact for clients , addressing requests, questions, and issues in a timely and professional manner.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Language Delivery, Technical Services, QA, and Supply Chain to ensure smooth project execution.
Prepare and update project quotes, schedules, budgets, and workflows based on project requirements.
Identify and manage production risks , implementing mitigation actions when necessary.
Monitor project progress and provide status updates, reporting, and post-mortem analysis to improve future processes.
Ensure compliance with internal procedures, ISO requirements, and quality standards .
Manage administrative project tasks such as project closure, translation memory updates, and documentation maintenance .
Oversee resource coordination , ensuring vendors and internal teams have the necessary tools, instructions, and information.
Support account development by identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction.
Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to improve workflows, processes, and project performance .
Provide guidance or task allocation to junior team members when required .

Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, English, Foreign Languages, Social/Applied Sciences, or a related field .
3–5 years of experience coordinating or managing projects within the localization or translation industry .
Proven client service and account management experience (typically at least 2 years).
Strong project management skills , including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
Experience working with translation management systems and CAT tools (e.g., TRADOS or similar tools).
Familiarity with publishing or content tools such as FrameMaker, InDesign, or similar platforms.
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Strong communication skills in written and spoken English .
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions with limited supervision.
High level of attention to detail and quality focus .
Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is a plus.
Fluency in an additional foreign language is a plus.
PMP certification is considered an advantage.

Life at RWS

Life at RWS
-
If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood , then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner
, putting clients fist and winning together , to pioneer
, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress
, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver
, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI
and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Recruitment Agencies:
RWS Holdings PLC does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward any unsolicited resumes to any RWS employees. Any unsolicited resume received will be treated as the property of RWS and Terms & Conditions associated with the use of such resume will be considered null and void.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Associate Project Manager to join IQVIA Laboratories in a remote role within the United States.

We hire passionate innovators who drive healthcare forward through thoughtful and inclusive collaboration. If you want to discover a career with greater purpose, join us as we transform and accelerate research and development.

The Associate Project Manager supports the operational execution of projects and business priorities by coordinating project activities, stakeholder communications, reporting, executive support, and logistics. This role partners with project teams and senior leaders to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with established processes, timelines, and business objectives.

What You'll Be Doing

Create, track, and report on project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and financial metrics.
Produce and distribute project status, tracking, and financial reports for internal and external stakeholders, including senior management.
Support senior leadership by coordinating priorities, managing information flow, and assisting with executive-level communications and meeting preparation.
Coordinate stakeholder engagement and communications across multiple teams to ensure alignment on project objectives and business priorities.
Facilitate meeting governance by developing agendas, documenting key decisions, tracking action items, and following up on deliverables.
Manage project budgets, invoice approvals, financial reporting, and deliverable tracking to support successful project execution.
Coordinate complex scheduling, travel arrangements, and logistics in support of project and business activities.
Partner with project teams and business stakeholders to drive project execution, support strategic initiatives, and identify process improvement opportunities.

What We Are Looking For

Bachelor’s Degree required.
Minimum of 3 years of related experience in project coordination, business operations, administration, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree.

The Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Needed For This Role

Strong project coordination, organizational, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, executive support, relationship-building, and meeting facilitation skills.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, decision-support, and organizational capabilities with attention to detail and a focus on delivering results.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, clients, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.

What We Offer You

We put our employees at the center of everything we do and are committed to providing them, and their families, with benefits that meet their diverse and changing needs. We invest in integrated benefits programs and resources to take care of our employees’ physical, mental and emotional, financial and social well-being so they can thrive at home and at work, at any stage of their well-being journey.

To learn more about our benefits, visit https://jobs.iqvia.com/benefits.

If you’re looking to unleash your potential, join IQVIA Laboratories to help make the extraordinary possible!

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

jobs.title: Project Manager, IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science
jobs.description:
To be considered for this role, you must currently reside in the country the role is posted in.

This opportunity has the potential to be remote for a strong candidate that is not located near an east coast office. However, there is a very strong preference for someone that can work a hybrid schedule and go into the New York, Boston, Wayne, Parsippany, or Durham locations several days per week. This preference is due to supporting global teams in different time zones.

About The Team

IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science contributes to advancing human health by generating rigorous, evidence-based research. IQVIA Institute utilizes proprietary data sources, subject matter experts, advanced analytical skills, academic and external partners to conduct research and develop objective and data driven reports. These reports are intended for a broad set of stakeholders across the health system, such as policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc. Our reports are widely downloaded with nearly 70,000 downloads last year along with over 600 citations in scholarly publications. Research at the IQVIA Institute can vary in size and complexity. We apply quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to a a variety of IQVIA data sources, external data sources and secondary literature to develop our reports. IQVIA Institute provides an opportunity to engage with crucial public health and public policy topics that can improve patient lives across the globe and to interact with key opinion leaders and stakeholders in these spaces. You'll enjoy a rewarding career in a collaborative, multicultural environment that values growth and development.

Role Overview

Project Managers are an integral part of funded research projects.

They are responsible for the on-time completion of projects or components of large, complex projects for clients in the life sciences field related to funded reports and research. They also identify and elevate potential new business opportunities and assists in the sales process. Their projects range in complexity from basic analysis and problem solving to assisting in the development of more complex solutions. PM's serve as project leaders and manage the client relationship associated with specific projects. These projects may be done in partnership with several other teams across IQVIA. The research and reports led by the senior consultant contribute to public health and public policy discourse across the globe and are well respected and used by stakeholders across the healthcare system (from policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc.)

Essential Functions

Participate or lead teams in the design, development and delivery of funded research projects or components of larger, complex projects.
Review and analyze client requirements or problems and assist in the development of proposals of cost effective solutions that ensure profitability and high client satisfaction while meeting IQVIA Institute standards
Provide direction and guidance to Analysts, Consultants, and where relevant, to Statistical Services assigned to engagement.
Develop detailed documentation and specifications.
Perform qualitative and/or quantitative analyses to assist in the development of tailored funded research solutions.
Design, structure and deliver reports and presentations that are appropriate to the characteristics or needs of the audience.
Recommend improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems.
Identify potential new business opportunities of follow-on work and new leads at assigned client.
Provide follow-up with client after project deliverable has been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
Proactively develop broader and deeper knowledge of methodologies and life sciences industry, healthcare policy globally through on the job experience and participation in training opportunities. Begin to develop subject matter expertise across healthcare system topics
When acting as Project Manager, proactively manage project timelines and manage day to day communication with the client and team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, public health or other related field required. MBA, MPH, PhD with a life sciences or healthcare focus preferred.
Typically possesses 5-8 years of post-undergraduate experience or 3-5 years of post Masters experience.
Possesses solid project management skills and client management and relationship building skills.
Experienced with developing consultative relationships with senior level managers and executives at clients in the life science industry.
Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
Knowledge of consulting and research methodologies, tools and techniques related to functional area.
Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the life science industry and healthcare system across countries.
Necessary subject matter expertise to effectively manage projects.
Results oriented approach to work delivery and output. Ability to solve problems independently and creatively.
Effective communication - strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. Excellent presentation, communication and client management skills.
Quality: High attention to detail and accuracy in work.
IT skills: Proficient software and computer skills, including MS Office applications, including but not limited to, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Intermediate or advanced Excel skill level preferred.
Collaboration: Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients. Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is $95,700.00 - $239,200.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

The Project Manager successfully manages the implementation of Tyler software for new and existing accounts, from the contract signing through a formal transition to the Customer Support Account Manager (CSAM) and Support Teams, on time and within budget.

Responsibilities

Develop the implementation project plan and officially start projects by conducting kick-off meetings with clients and other staff as needed. Project plans outline the scope, schedule, and budget of the project, as well as each party’s responsibilities and mutual commitment to contribute adequate resources to follow the plan.
Work with the sales team as the contract is signed, becoming familiar with contract requirements, program modifications, and other site-specific background information.
Manage and assume accountability for all aspects of projects related to delivery of client software and services including:
Acquiring and coordinating necessary resources to meet project needs.
Planning and tracking all project activity.
Guiding the client through release planning in support of the overall project schedule.
Tracking project hours and submitting monthly project status reports.
Monitoring and reviewing revenue recognition and bringing concerns to management as needed.
Managing scope, time and cost to meet client commitments.
Managing communication throughout the team and stakeholders.
Managing the quality of project team deliverables.
Managing the project budget.
Documenting and reporting status and issues.
Identifying, reporting and managing risks; overcoming project obstacles.
Acting as a client liaison and representative communicating client feedback to appropriate Tyler representatives; acting to resolve outstanding issues on behalf of client in a timely manner.
Conduct planning sessions with the client’s key functional leaders to create documented management plans that specify the project plan and scope.
Responsible for ensuring assigned clients pay invoices in a timely manner and/or assist Tyler collections in obtaining payment for delinquent/past due accounts.
Ensure that resources are scheduled and monitor progress to ensure compliance with the project plan, immediately notifying affected parties of any schedule changes.
Use departmental sites/calendars/systems to publish a summary of key dates and issues to all Tyler employees involved in the project, such as development, implementation, support, and other project managers.
Obtain regular feedback from clients regarding project status and quality of service and take immediate corrective action as required.
Anticipate, identify, and resolve roadblocks, such as hardware, software, or networking incompatibilities and unresponsive third-party vendors or clients.
Communicate completion of milestones to clients and secure formal acceptance from them.
Upon project completion conduct meetings with clients to ensure a smooth transition of services from implementation to CSAM and Support Teams.
Communicate with the implementation staff and management regularly, ensuring timely delivery of schedules and revenue projections; relaying personnel, client, contract, and departmental issues; seeking assistance as needed with meeting revenue goals; and responding to directives that are issued to meet department goals.
May manage implementation resources to maximize performance and deliver expected revenue goals.
Maintain the project plan commitments and status by keeping all project event information current.
May identify add-on sales opportunities and manage change orders and/or contract addendums.
Travel to client site as needed.

Qualifications

Typically, a minimum of three years of experience as an implementation professional (or equivalent/like experience). Solid and proven project management experience essential.
Experience in Public Safety domain and/or experience using Enterprise Public Safety software, or equivalent software solution.
Work toward obtaining PMP certification and maintain status after certification.
Software life cycle and enterprise software knowledge.
Excellent planning, organizational skills and ability to follow-through until process are completed.
Exceptional customer service skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and non-technical information to various audiences including management.
Proficiency using computers and exposure to IT infrastructure components.
Strong decision making and problem-solving skills.
Strong analytical ability, particularly in a technical environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and Project.
Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and persuasion skills.
Valid driver’s license.
Ability to travel.
Public Safety Experience Required

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, CX Operations & Programs
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Experience (CX) Operations & Programs team, you’ll lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and turn customer insight into action. You’ll bring structure to complex priorities, improve how teams plan and execute, and help connect customer feedback to better experiences, product decisions, adoption, retention, and advocacy—advancing 1Password’s mission through meaningful customer impact. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Operations & Programs, this role is remote in Canada or the United States, with a preference for Eastern Time.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What We're Looking For

6+ years of experience in program management, operations, strategy and operations, or a related field, including work on customer-focused programs.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial scope through implementation, adoption, and transition to ongoing ownership.
Ability to create structure from ambiguity, right-size processes, manage competing priorities, and move work forward with sound judgment.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience influencing partners without formal authority and aligning teams with different priorities, working styles, and levels of technical knowledge.
Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools and automation to improve research, analysis, planning, communication, workflow execution, or operational efficiency.
Preferred: Experience in Customer Success, customer engagement, Voice of Customer, customer advocacy, customer insights, customer content, digital engagement, or customer education. Familiarity with tools such as Asana or Notion, or a project management certification, is also helpful.

What You Can Expect

Lead strategic programs across customer engagement, including Voice of Customer, customer content, advocacy, and related initiatives.
Establish clear plans, owners, milestones, dependencies, success measures, and operating rhythms that improve visibility and execution.
Build scalable ways to collect, synthesize, and activate customer feedback, connecting insights to decisions, communications, and measurable improvements.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer journeys, handoffs, feedback loops, and other important moments across the customer lifecycle.
Partner with Customer Experience, Go To Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and other teams to manage tradeoffs and deliver shared outcomes.
Present concise, recommendation-led updates in team meetings, company forums, and executive discussions.
Support rollout, communications, enablement, and adoption for new programs, processes, tools, and ways of working, while identifying opportunities for simplification and automation.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $131,000 USD and $190,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $110,000 CAD and $160,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. jobs.description:
Department:
DevCon

Employment Type:
Permanent - Full Time

Location:
UK - Remote

Description

Field has entered its next phase of growth. In June, the UK energy regulator, Ofgem, selected 16 long-duration energy storage projects to progress to delivery. Field were awarded 5 of these. Collectively, in MWh terms, our projects are approximately 3 times the capacity of all battery energy storage installed in the UK to date. We currently have 4 projects totalling over 1GWh of energy storage in construction in GB with lots more delivery to do.

Your Mission

As Assistant Project Manager at Field you will support some of the world’s longest duration BESS projects through pre-construction, final-investment decision (FID), construction, commissioning and handover to Operations.

The role requires active management of your projects under the direction of the Project Manager, you therefore need to be highly engaged, resilient, execution-focused and detail-oriented. You’ll need to be passionate about project management fundamentals (e.g. programme, budget, quality) and have proven stakeholder management and communication skills.

You will report to the Head of Delivery (Michael) and work closely with in-house experts across Engineering, QHSE, Procurement, Legal and Development. Day-to-day you will work alongside more senior Project Managers as part of a core project team, driving projects through pre-construction and construction.

This is a role for aspiring project managers to take more responsibility and gain hands-on project management experience. There will be great opportunities for career progression and we are seeking candidates who want to progress into more senior roles.

Key Responsibilities

What You’ll Be Doing

This is a broad and varied role with the opportunity to have massive impact. Key responsibilities including

Support the Project Managers (PM) through the pre-construction phase of the project (following end of the planning & development phase, or following the acquisition of a RTB Asset)
Assisting PMs with general day to day activities, with opportunities to take management responsibilities for some packages of work.
Coordinate and support an internal project team in the run-up to Final Investment Decision (FID), with a sharp focus on programme
Support planning discharge activities with the development team and engagement with landowners to ensure land-related obligations are met
Support PM’s to manage the performance of services carried out by consultants we appoint to support on the execution of the projects such as Technical Advisors, Health and Safety, and Environmental.
Manage, update and interpret and the pre-construction risk register, the master project-schedule, project-budget and action tracker (what we call the “basics” from which all activities are prioritised)

Support the PM to manage the construction phase to safely meet agreed time, quality and budget targets
Lead by example and ensure our health & safety culture is adopted on all projects
Manage our construction contracts, including the BESS supplier, BoP contractor, TO, grid-compliance and any other packages of work required for the project
Help deliver all “Client” responsibilities noted within the employer’s requirements and interface matrix of construction contracts. This includes managing variations to planning, meeting our lease commitments and sourcing free-issue equipment and services (e.g. fibre, fiscal metres, RTM provider)
Support the by ensuring key project management documents are prepared to an excellent standard in line with the business reporting calendar

Ensure the project seamlessly enters commercial operation & close-out contracts
Coordinate with our commercial operations team and asset managers on revenue readiness activities
Have a clear understanding on how our construction schedules impact on revenue streams (e.g. Capacity Market milestone dates)
Agree (and manage the close-out) of construction defects and settle final accounts with support of the contract manager

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The Skills You’ll Need

Engineering, construction, science, commercial or project-management background. Ideally with minimum 3 years of experience (relevant graduate schemes will also be considered)
Experience on energy infrastructure projects is a bonus (batteries, onshore or offshore wind, solar, peaking plants, interconnectors/HVDC, thermal power generation)
You’re an open, clear communicator (written and verbal) who enjoys working collaboratively
You love Gantt charts, risk registers and attending site!
You have a curious mind and pride yourself on always learning, adapting and improving
You’re known as a problem solver, someone who enjoys bringing order to chaos and taking quick action to move things forward
You’re known for your personal integrity - you don’t cut corners and you’re quick to acknowledge and learn from your mistakes
You have a growth mindset and a humble outlook - you share openly, both the good and the bad
You’re enthusiastic about project management and its application in the delivery of green energy projects

Benefits

Package Details

Salary: DOE

We’re offering a competitive compensation package, including participation in our employee share scheme which rewards all employees for the growth of the business. You’ll be awarded shares when you join, which will vest over four years - and as the business grows in size and value, so will your shares!

We value our team’s wellbeing and belonging so we invest approx £5,000 a year on a range of perks, benefits and wellbeing activities, including regular team socials and events.

Other Benefits Include

Up to 10% Company wide bonus based on company performance
Hybrid working (blend of home and office working to suit individual needs)
£2,000 per year to spend on your professional development
Private medical cover with Bupa from day one with the option to add family members.
Company Pension with 8% Contribution
Enhanced parental leave, for all new parents:
6 months fully paid primary carer leave
3 months fully paid secondary carer leave
10 days fully paid leave for fertility treatment

Fun co-working office space in Shoreditch, London
1 month work from anywhere, for those with a travel bug
1 day green leave to do something good for the environment
free lunch once a week - a great way to get to know people in the wider team
dog friendly office, feel free to bring your pooch along
Spill: our mental health benefit allowing every Fielder access to equal and unrestricted therapy and resources
Regular, optional team socials designed to be inclusive for everyone (not just the pub goers!)
Birthday carbon offset: a gift from Field to the world to celebrate your birthday

A Bit About Field

Field is an international builder, owner, and operator of renewable infrastructure. Founded by a successful entrepreneur, we have robust BESS project pipelines across the UK, Italy, Spain, and Germany, backed by a recent £200 million investment from DIF Capital Partners. Our mission is to grow internationally and develop a strong global BESS portfolio.

We are an eclectic team with diverse backgrounds, from scaling billion-dollar tech startups to building energy companies and specializing in energy markets. You'll work with fun, curious, entrepreneurial people making a real impact. We're proving batteries are a viable energy solution now. Our ambitious plans include becoming Europe's leading clean energy player and expanding beyond batteries into new assets.

Our Values

Work for the team - We are friendly and approachable. We make time for each other, value diverse perspectives, and learn and grow together.
Do it right - We prioritise doing things right, never cutting corners. Safety comes first, and we consider our impact on communities and the environment. We act with integrity always.
Move fast - We’re doers. We take responsibility, deliver on promises, and get things done. FAST.
Know your stuff - We’re curious self-starters, always learning, adapting, and improving. No question is too small. We own our growth.

Read more about our values at www.field.energy

Love the sound of Field but not sure this role is right for you? Have a look at our careers page and register your CV. We are always interested in candidates who have exposure to BESS and work within the Renewable Energy space. We’d love to hear from you

Equality, Diversity & inclusion

Diverse teams make better teams. Field is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment which is as representative as possible of our society. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender expression, marriage/civil partnership status, pregnancy/maternity status, race, nationality, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. We published a blog discussing our findings and learnings from our first Equity, Diversity and Inclusion survey in March 2023 which you can read here.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished Lead Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) and Server Operations programs across parts of North America.

This Lead Principal TPM will provide strategic and operational program leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix support, and automation across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish scalable program mechanisms that enable rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, workforce effectiveness, and technical rigor. This leader will partner across engineering and operations teams, standardize execution across multiple sites, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and data-driven program management.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions while improving the systems, tools, and operating rhythms that support reliable cloud infrastructure at scale.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong program leader with a proven track record of driving large-scale infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation programs through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations execution across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide program leadership for Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations initiatives across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix operations, and operational automation.
Develop and execute scalable program frameworks capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple sites and cross-functional teams.
Lead complex, geographically distributed programs that improve operational performance, safety, security, availability, and service quality across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, strengthening program governance, and implementing best practices across regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, scripting, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and manual effort.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing program risk, dependencies, and execution gaps.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Senior technical program management experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, software development, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience driving large, geographically distributed programs across multiple teams, sites, and operational functions.
Demonstrated success scaling operational systems, program mechanisms, and execution models within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, distributed systems, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, networking, storage, compute, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, scripting, process engineering, and scalable program models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities, operational analytics, Jira, Confluence, and related program tooling to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, technical judgment, program execution, and written and verbal communication.
Strong executive presence with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering and operations teams in collaborative, agile environments while driving clarity, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Education

A Bachelors’ degree is preferred. An advanced degree is a plus.

Qualifications

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager

Als Technical Project Manager werk je op het snijvlak van klanten, technologie en operations. Je vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen, koppelingen en processen werken en bouwt daardoor stap voor stap steeds meer technische kennis op. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de rol is stakeholdermanagement. Je schakelt met klanten, interne collega’s en technische specialisten, bewaakt verwachtingen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat de volgende stap is. Ook wanneer iets niet volgens plan verloopt, blijf je duidelijk, professioneel en diplomatiek communiceren.

Wat ga je doen?

Klant- en operationsprojecten coördineren van start tot afronding.
Klanten begeleiden bij implementaties van koppelingen, integraties en tools.
Afstemmen met klanten en interne stakeholders over planning, voortgang en knelpunten.
Tickets, bugs en technische vragen onderzoeken en opvolgen.
Informatie verzamelen en een eerste analyse doen voordat je een issue doorzet naar een specialist.
Acties bewaken en zorgen dat vragen en problemen daadwerkelijk worden afgerond.
Kennis, oplossingen en werkwijzen documenteren en delen.
Samenwerken met ervaren Operations Specialists met verschillende expertisegebieden.

Wat zoeken we?

Je Past Goed Bij Deze Rol Als Je

sterk bent in communicatie en stakeholdermanagement;
diplomatiek kunt omgaan met verschillende belangen en verwachtingen;
nieuwsgierig bent en graag zelf dingen uitzoekt;
analytisch en gestructureerd werkt;
verantwoordelijkheid neemt en afspraken goed opvolgt;
affiniteit hebt met technologie en nieuwe systemen snel oppakt;
zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook gemakkelijk de samenwerking opzoekt;
niet schrikt van technische onderwerpen, ook als je nog niet alles begrijpt.
professioneel kunt communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Technische kennis is een plus, maar geen harde eis. We zoeken vooral iemand met de juiste houding: iemand die wil begrijpen hoe iets werkt, goede vragen stelt en zich technische onderwerpen snel eigen maakt.

Werkplek

Hybride werken: drie dagen op kantoor in Utrecht en twee dagen flexibel.
Informele, pragmatische en no-nonsense cultuur.
Internationaal team met korte communicatielijnen.

Reducate is marktleider in online Continuing Professional Education (e-CPE) en helpt professionals in heel Europa om hun kennis actueel te houden. Onze cultuur is no-nonsense, ambitieus en gericht op elke dag een beetje beter worden. We werken samen, ondersteunen elkaar en vieren successen.

Experience managing integrated master schedules, change control, risks/issues, scope, requirements, deliverables, and executive governance processes.

Location:
Dallas, TX
Employment Type:
Direct Hire

Hybrid

SVP, Infrastructure Programs
Overview
Our client is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the coordinated delivery of a large-scale, multi-year data center and high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure program.
This individual will oversee the integrated program plan across design, engineering, construction, power, cooling, procurement, commissioning, and HPC infrastructure deployment. The role will connect facility delivery with compute, storage, networking, and platform readiness, ensuring all workstreams align with program milestones and operational requirements.
Individual Project Managers, engineering leaders, contractors, and functional teams will own specific scopes. The Program Manager will provide program-level oversight across schedule, budget, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments, driving coordination from initial planning through operational turnover.
This hybrid position requires regular in-person collaboration in Dallas with executive leadership and engineering, construction, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Key Responsibilities
Program Delivery and Governance
Oversee end-to-end program delivery from planning and design through construction, infrastructure deployment, commissioning, and operational readiness.
Develop and maintain an integrated master program plan spanning facility development and HPC infrastructure workstreams.
Track program schedules, capital budgets, forecasts, milestones, quality, risks, and delivery performance.
Align individual project plans with overall program objectives, phased capacity requirements, and business commitments.
Establish consistent governance, reporting, milestone reviews, escalation processes, and accountability.
Maintain risk, assumption, issue, and dependency logs, along with change control and decision tracking.
Identify critical-path issues, resource constraints, and schedule conflicts; drive mitigation and recovery plans.

Data Center and HPC Infrastructure Integration
Coordinate dependencies across utility power, on-site generation, electrical distribution, cooling, controls, compute, storage, and networking.
Integrate HPC deployment milestones into the overall facility construction and commissioning schedule.
Align GPU and CPU hardware delivery, rack installation, high-speed network connectivity, storage deployment, and platform readiness with available power, cooling, and floor space.
Partner with technical leaders to track readiness for cluster installation, configuration, validation, and production handoff.
Coordinate high-density infrastructure requirements, including liquid cooling, rack power, network fabrics, and supporting mechanical systems.
Manage sequencing between facility turnover, equipment installation, infrastructure testing, and workload readiness.
Track dependencies across hardware vendors, infrastructure teams, platform engineering, and operations.

Cross-Functional and Project Coordination
Serve as the central coordination point across engineering, construction, procurement, supply chain, finance, technology, commissioning, and operations.
Provide program-level oversight across Project Managers responsible for individual projects, phases, and infrastructure workstreams.
Integrate project schedules and resolve issues that extend across multiple teams or scopes.
Align design completion, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and turnover activities.
Coordinate long-lead equipment, material availability, vendor capacity, and supply chain risks.
Partner with finance on capital planning, expenditure tracking, forecasting, and budget reporting.
Coordinate with utility providers, permitting authorities, municipalities, and other external stakeholders as required.

Vendor and Contractor Oversight
Monitor program commitments across general contractors, specialty contractors, engineering partners, equipment manufacturers, technology vendors, and commissioning providers.
Track performance against contractual milestones, schedules, quality requirements, and delivery expectations.
Identify vendor risks affecting construction progress, HPC deployment, commissioning, or operational readiness.
Ensure external partners understand program priorities, sequencing, and cross-functional dependencies.
Drive resolution of delivery gaps with internal workstream owners and external partners.

Schedule, Risk, and Change Management
Maintain visibility into the integrated master schedule and overall critical path.
Monitor procurement timelines, construction sequencing, infrastructure deployment, and commissioning dependencies.
Identify emerging risks and lead mitigation, contingency, and recovery planning.
Evaluate scope, design, and schedule changes for impacts on cost, capacity, technical readiness, and delivery milestones.
Ensure major changes are documented, approved, and communicated.
Escalate significant risks and decisions to senior leadership with clear business impacts and recommendations.

Commissioning and Operational Readiness
Integrate commissioning and technical validation activities into the overall delivery plan.
Coordinate construction completion, equipment startup, integrated systems testing, punch-list resolution, and turnover.
Track readiness across electrical, mechanical, controls, networking, security, life safety, and HPC infrastructure.
Partner with technical teams to incorporate cluster acceptance testing, performance validation, and infrastructure handoff into program milestones.
Ensure operations staffing, procedures, documentation, training, and support requirements are ready for turnover.
Support phased delivery where construction, commissioning, infrastructure deployment, and live operations occur simultaneously.

Executive Reporting
Maintain executive dashboards covering schedule, budget, procurement, construction, HPC deployment, commissioning, risk, and overall program health.
Provide clear visibility into critical-path activities, upcoming milestones, delivery forecasts, and required decisions.
Translate complex technical and construction issues into business impacts and actionable recommendations.
Maintain accurate forecasts for capital requirements, capacity availability, and operational turnover.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
10+ years of experience in program management, project management, data center delivery, infrastructure deployment, construction, engineering, or large-scale capital programs.
Demonstrated experience overseeing complex, multi-year, multi-phase infrastructure or construction programs.
Direct experience delivering data centers, HPC facilities, cloud infrastructure, colocation facilities, or comparable mission-critical technical environments.

Experience coordinating engineering, construction, procurement, commissioning, and operational readiness.

AI Fabrik builds an edge inference delivery network for high-performance tokens, with faster time-to-market from grid to tokens. Our mission is to build the inference infrastructure we wished every enterprise already had — close to users, close to the cloud, and extremely resilient for real-time workloads. We are builders, architects, engineers, and researchers with hands-on experience in real-world AI deployment in production, and decades of data center experience that taught us exactly what needs to change.

AI Fabrik was incubated inside Gruve and backed by Mayfield , Xora (Temasek), Acclimate Ventures , Cisco Investments — existing investors from Gruve who followed us into this new chapter. We are deploying five initial production sites, with the first one coming online in July 2026.

About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of physical infrastructure deployment and software engineering. Our programs span the buildout of hardware sites across dozens of locations — facilities, power, networking, and compute — alongside the delivery of a deep software stack that must be production-ready when each site comes online.

The multiple related workstreams run in parallel and are tightly coupled. Hardware procurement and site construction operate on fixed schedules with limited room for adjustment. Software delivery must be planned and tracked with the same discipline. The TPM in this role is accountable for keeping both on track and ensuring the dependencies between them are managed proactively, not discovered late.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale technical programs: define scope, set milestones, sequence dependencies, and keep delivery on track across multiple engineering teams
Engage directly with system designs, architecture decisions, and infrastructure trade-offs — well enough to identify risks, ask the right questions, and flag issues before they compound
Manage cross-functional dependencies across engineering, product, design, data, and infrastructure; keep teams aligned without creating process overhead that slows them down
Communicate program status, risks, and decisions to different audiences — architectural context for engineering leads, delivery forecasts for product, business impact for executives — adapting the level of detail to what each stakeholder actually needs
Identify, track, and escalate technical risks early; own the mitigation plan and follow through to resolution rather than handing it off
Run the operational rhythm of the program: standups, steering meetings, decision logs, and retrospectives — with a bias toward async where possible
Write and maintain clear program documentation: specs, decision records, dependency maps, and status reports that teams actually read and reference
Drive post-launch reviews and feed learnings back into how the next program runs

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of experience in a technical role — software engineering, infrastructure, or a closely related discipline — before or alongside program management work
Demonstrable experience running large, cross-functional technical programs from planning through delivery
Comfortable reading system design documents, architecture diagrams, and API specs; able to engage meaningfully with engineers on technical trade-offs without needing to write the code
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust detail and framing depending on the audience
Experience managing dependencies and coordinating delivery across multiple teams simultaneously
Familiarity with project and program management tools (Jira, Confluence, Linear, or equivalent)
Solid understanding of modern software delivery practices: CI/CD pipelines, agile methodologies, and release management

Preferred Qualifications

Background in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or platform engineering — giving you the vocabulary and intuition to engage on architecture without needing a technical translator
Experience running programs in high-ambiguity environments where the scope evolves and the requirements are still being worked out
Familiarity with risk frameworks and structured approaches to dependency mapping across large engineering organizations
Experience coordinating security, compliance, or data privacy requirements as part of a technical program
Track record of improving how programs run — not just delivering on time, but leaving better processes behind

Salary Range

$160,000 - $240,000 USD + Benefits

Why AI Fabrik

At AI Fabrik, we hire for impact. We want those who challenge how inference infrastructure is built and who excel at delivering it in production. We are builders, architects, engineers, and researchers. We move fast, work with rigor, and care deeply about what runs in the real world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. AI Fabrik is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please note that this is an onsite position based out of AI Fabrik’s Redwood City, California office.

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to understand operational challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into clear execution plans, documentation, analytics solutions, and measurable outcomes.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of business processes, reporting practices, and operational effectiveness across the organization.

What you will bring

6+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Analysis, Operations, or a related function supporting enterprise-scale initiatives.

Experience creating and maintaining dashboards and data visualizations using Looker Studio or comparable BI platforms.

An inspirational place for you to do your best work, be engaged in meaningful ways, and continually develop the skills, competencies and qualities that set our team apart.

jobs.title: Rollout Program Manager
jobs.description:
Context and role purpose

CEO Coaching International is introducing BIG Intelligence to augment its coaching services and support its evolution into a technology-enabled services business. The platform includes three modules: Client, Coach, and Firm. Each will require ongoing rollout support as capabilities expand, alongside the introduction of new CEOCI services.
This is a permanent, full-time position. The initial assignment is the phased client rollout from Alpha, planned for November 2026, through Beta, Early Access, and General Availability, currently targeted for May 2027. The role builds and executes the operating plan that prepares clients, coaches, and internal teams to use and support the platform.
After the initial launch, the role continues to manage operational rollouts across all three modules and new services. This includes repeatable readiness, enablement, onboarding, communications, and support handoffs for an ongoing software release cadence of approximately every two to three weeks. The level of rollout activity should match the impact of each release; larger capabilities and services may require coordinated launch programs.
Role scope and accountability

The Rollout Program Manager (RPM)’s primary responsibility is to own the integrated rollout execution. This includes overseeing the launch plans, dependencies & milestone. The RPM will also help assess, identify and mitigate operational readiness, risk management, and escalations. The RPM will also coordinate functional deliverables and secure commitments from their owners.
The RPM sits within the Client Success Organization, reporting to the Chief Client Officer. The CCO and Client Success organization own ongoing client adoption, customer experience, and support. Within this context, the RPM coordinates rollout enablement and support readiness, monitors results, and drives follow-through with accountable owners. It may challenge readiness, recommend delaying or resequencing deployment, and escalate unresolved issues. Final decisions remain with designated functional and executive owners.

The RPM is NOT responsible for the following:
Product vision, strategy, roadmap, requirements, feature prioritization, product acceptance, and release scope remain with the Chief Product Officer and Product Management.
Positioning, messaging, differentiation, go-to-market strategy, and launch communications remain with Product Marketing under the CPO.
Engineering and AI leadership own technical delivery, quality, security, reliability, and technical readiness.

Working relationships

The RPM works closely with the CPO, Product Management, Chief AI Officer, Engineering, internal and outsourced development teams, Product Marketing, L&D, Client Success, support, participating coaches, and Firm module process owners.

Core responsibilities

Integrated rollout planning
Maintain one operating plan across platform modules and new services, with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, capacity needs, risks, and decisions. Coordinate initial launch phases and ongoing releases, using repeatable and automated workflows where practical.
Operational readiness and expansion
Translate approved product scope and service plans into readiness requirements for onboarding, training, communications, user participation, and support. Gather functional readiness evidence and present recommendations on deployment timing and expansion. Keep product release readiness distinct from operational rollout readiness.
Coach adoption and organizational change
Coordinate coach onboarding, training, office hours, and practical guidance for incorporating BIG Intelligence into coaching relationships. Develop early coach champions with L&D and Client Success, capture evidence of successful use, and identify resistance or workflow barriers that need action.
Client and Firm onboarding
Coordinate participant selection, rollout waves, access setup, onboarding, and feedback collection with the appropriate owners. Integrate platform onboarding into new coaching-client onboarding. Work with internal process owners to prepare Firm users for new capabilities and changes to their work.
Release enablement and communications
Coordinate Product Marketing, Product, and L&D deliverables so guidance, approved messaging, and training are ready when needed. Match enablement effort to the scale of the change and coordinate larger launches when appropriate.
Feedback and support coordination
Use Product’s established intake and classification process for defects and usability issues. Coordinate visibility and handoffs across product issues, training gaps, and adoption barriers without creating a parallel product backlog. Track unresolved issues and ensure clear ownership and user follow-through.
Scalable support readiness
Coordinate support workflows, knowledge resources, escalation paths, service expectations, and internal or third-party capacity. A designated internal software customer success/support owner manages support operations, vendor performance, and escalated case follow-through. Engineering and AI own technical diagnosis and fixes.
Measurement and continuous improvement
Maintain a concise scorecard covering readiness, activation, repeat use, coach participation, user feedback, support demand, and unresolved issues. Agree measures and targets with functional owners, compare rollout cohorts, and drive corrective actions. Transfer routine delivery tasks to operational owners while retaining responsibility for future rollout coordination and process improvement.

What success looks like

Launch phases and ongoing rollouts have clear owners, measurable readiness criteria, and credible plans. Leadership receives reliable evidence for deployment and expansion decisions.
Coaches, clients, and Firm users receive timely enablement and support; recurring rollout processes operate consistently and fit the release cadence.
Adoption and value measures inform action. Product owns product value and capabilities; Client Success owns ongoing client adoption and success; Firm process owners own internal business outcomes.

Required experience

At least five years in software program management, implementation, launch operations, or a closely related role, with direct accountability for delivery across multiple functions.
Taken at least two software products or substantial releases from a controlled pilot or Beta into broader customer availability, with concrete examples of personal ownership and results.
Managed rollout work beyond development delivery, including onboarding, training, communications, support readiness, and adoption.
Built practical processes in entrepreneurial software environments where workflows, responsibilities, and organizational capabilities were still developing.
Coordinated recurring SaaS releases and organizational change, including enablement and onboarding that continue after the initial launch.
Managed senior stakeholders and competing priorities, securing commitments and resolving dependencies without direct reporting authority.
Used customer feedback and operational data to adjust rollout plans, with examples of difficult decisions, corrective action, and lessons learned.

Required skills
Program execution and judgment.
Identify the critical path, clarify ownership, resolve delivery risks, and make evidence-based readiness recommendations.
Technical fluency.
Understand release cycles, testing, environments, defects, integrations, access management, and incident escalation sufficiently to coordinate decisions with technical owners.
Adoption and change management
. Introduce new workflows into established professional relationships, coordinate training, develop champions, and address barriers to sustained use.
Operational design and analysis.
Build usable, scalable workflows; automate repeatable steps where appropriate; interpret activation, repeat use, support demand, and cohort performance.
Executive communication and influence.
Provide concise updates on progress, risks, required decisions, and accountable owners. Challenge readiness constructively and surface disagreements early.
Hands-on execution
. Run onboarding sessions, organize feedback, validate user workflows, prepare operational guidance, and solve practical rollout problems.

Preferred experience
Introducing software into a professional services or relationship-driven business;
launching AI-enabled products; supporting executive users;
building customer success, support, or enablement processes;
launching new services; and coordinating small internal teams with outsourced development or support partners.

Education and hiring emphasis
Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (required).
Relevant program management, Agile, Scrum, or change management certifications (preferred)
An advanced degree is not required.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The Role

Pilot is building a first-of-its-kind, hybrid software/service solution to tackle the financial back office (bookkeeping, tax, CFO, etc.) so founders and business owners can focus on building and running their businesses. We work with thousands of customers in the tech startup and SMB sectors, and we're growing quickly.

Customer Operations is made up of 150+ employees who partner with our customers to manage their financial back office and support their business goals. This is an individual contributor role reporting into the Head of Business Operations, working closely with Customer Operations service delivery teams, cross-functional partners, and peer Business Operations Analysts.

This role sits at the center of how we plan, allocate, and forecast work across the organization, and increasingly, how we automate that work. Pilot is moving fast toward agentic, AI-assisted operations, and this person will build and own the systems, models, and reporting that make that shift possible: work orchestration, KPI reporting, resource forecasting, and billing. This isn't a role for someone who wants to build one dashboard and maintain it. It's for someone who wants to keep building better systems as the work itself changes.

The role requires real fluency with data and automation tools (Excel/Sheets at an expert level, plus a builder's instinct for where AI and scripts can replace manual work), sharp attention to detail, and good judgment about what results imply for our strategy and performance. This person works directly with senior leadership.

This is a hybrid in-office role based in our San Francisco office.

Key Responsibilities

Work Orchestration: Own the systems and processes that plan and allocate work across the organization. Build and maintain the models that route work efficiently as volume, team capacity, and service lines change.
KPI Reporting: Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership a clear, accurate, real-time view of business performance. Know the data well enough to catch anomalies before they become someone else's problem.
Resource Forecasting: Build and maintain forecasting models that project staffing and capacity needs against demand. Translate forecasts into recommendations leadership can act on.
Billing Operations: Own billing sheet accuracy and process, including the reconciliation and QA that keeps them error-free at scale.
Automation & AI Adoption: Identify where manual, spreadsheet-based, or repetitive work can be automated or AI-assisted. Build these solutions directly rather than just recommending them, using tools like Excel/Sheets scripting, SQL, and emerging AI tooling.
Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to the processes, workflows, and systems this role owns, so accuracy and efficiency improve as the business changes. When an improvement requires cross-functional buildout, lead it end to end, including the change management to get it adopted.

About You

Experience: 3-5 years in business operations, analytics, or finance, ideally in a start-up or technology-forward environment, with a track record of actually building and running a system. Experience owning forecasting, billing, or resource-planning is a strong plus.
Technical Proficiency: Expert-level Excel/Sheets (formulas, modeling, automation/scripting), plus working proficiency in SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Looker). Comfort using AI tools like Claude Cowork.
Detail Orientation: A track record of getting the numbers right the first time.
Systems Thinking: Able to see how planning, allocation, forecasting, and billing connect, and to design solutions that account for the whole picture rather than one piece of it.
Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading the build or overhaul of an operational system, including the change management needed to get a team to adopt it.
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work directly with senior leadership and translate technical or data-heavy work into clear recommendations.

About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?

We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan
