Unit:
Massey Comprehensive Cancer Ctr MBU

Department:
Massey Central Admin

Department
Summary:
Massey Comprehensive Cancer Center

Mission: To reduce the state cancer burden for all Virginians by addressing the confluence between biological, social, and policy drivers through high-impact, cutting-edge research; person-centered care across the continuum, from prevention through survivorship; community integration; and training the next generation of community-centric researchers and healthcare professionals

Vision: To be a premier community-focused cancer center leading the nation in cancer health equity research and ensuring optimal health outcomes for all

Why Richmond?

Duties & Responsibilities

The Research Scientist and Tobacco Treatment Program Manager is a hybrid scientific and operational role that advances the Cancer Service Line’s cancer survivorship research portfolio while leading the day-to-day delivery and development of the Tobacco Treatment Service (TTS). The position develops and implements rigorous survivorship research protocols, conducts epidemiologic and outcomes analyses, contributes to grants and publications, and translates findings into practical improvements in supportive oncology care.

As manager of TTS, the position ensures accessible, evidence-informed tobacco treatment for patients and survivors; facilitates at least one group smoking-cessation session each week; coordinates referrals, documentation, follow-up, and program evaluation; collaborates with institutional tobacco researchers and clinical partners; represents the program in community cessation activities; and develops a research agenda aligned with the vision and strategic priorities of Massey Comprehensive Cancer Center. The role exercises independent judgment for routine-to-moderately complex research and program matters and refers high-risk clinical, regulatory, personnel, or financial issues to senior leadership.

Duties Include But Are Not Limited To

Cancer Survivorship Research —

Protocol development and implementation: Develop research questions, aims, conceptual frameworks, study designs, measures, analytic plans, power calculations, recruitment approaches, data-management plans, and operational workflows for cancer survivorship studies. Coordinate projects from concept and protocol development through IRB review, implementation, analysis, dissemination, and closeout.
Epidemiologic and outcomes research: Lead or support analyses using electronic health records, cancer registries, administrative data, surveys, national surveillance datasets, and other complex sources. Apply appropriate methods, which may include survival analysis, multilevel modeling, causal inference, systematic review, meta-analysis, predictive modeling, and mixed or quantitative program-evaluation approaches.
Research operations and compliance: Maintain accurate protocols, regulatory files, data dictionaries, standard operating procedures, timelines, decision logs, and quality controls. Monitor milestones, research volume, workload, and deliverables; identify barriers early; and coordinate corrective action with investigators and institutional partners.
Grant and scholarly development: Contribute scientific methods, preliminary analyses, literature synthesis, budgets or resource assumptions, and project plans to grant proposals. Prepare and co-author abstracts, manuscripts, presentations, technical reports, and sponsor deliverables; support compliant post-award implementation and project closeout.
Team science: Collaborate with faculty investigators, clinicians, biostatisticians, trainees, community-engagement teams, research administrators, and external partners. Provide methodological consultation and mentor students or junior team members in study design, data analysis, reproducible workflows, and interpretation.

Tobacco Treatment Program —

Program leadership and daily operations: Manage the operational delivery and continuous improvement of TTS across the Cancer Service Line. Establish annual goals, workflows, referral pathways, service standards, outreach plans, performance measures, and reporting processes consistent with Cancer Service Line and Massey priorities.
Direct tobacco-treatment services: Plan and facilitate at least one structured group smoking-cessation session each week for patients, survivors, caregivers, or other approved participants. Provide evidence-informed education, behavioral counseling, relapse-prevention support, and connections to appropriate clinical and community resources within professional scope and institutional policy.
Care coordination and access: Partner with oncology, primary care, supportive services, pharmacy, nursing, social work, navigation, and digital-health teams to strengthen identification, referral, enrollment, follow-up, and continuity. Ensure timely documentation and escalation of medication, mental-health, safety, or other clinical issues to licensed treating professionals.
Institutional research collaboration: Build active collaborations with Massey and VCU tobacco researchers to integrate clinical service delivery with implementation science, population health, health-equity, and survivorship research. Support pilot studies, pragmatic evaluations, clinical research recruitment, and translation of evidence into practice.
Community engagement: Participate in community education, screening, outreach, and smoking-cessation activities, including partnerships serving populations with high tobacco burden or barriers to care. Adapt engagement strategies to community priorities and support bidirectional communication with community partners.
Research agenda and evaluation: Develop and maintain a multi-year TTS research and evaluation agenda aligned with Massey’s vision. Define priority questions, populations, outcomes, data sources, funding opportunities, dissemination plans, and partnership needs. Track reach, engagement, service delivery, treatment completion, patient-reported outcomes, quit-related outcomes, disparities, and implementation measures using approved definitions and methods.
Quality and sustainability: Use performance data, participant feedback, current evidence, and stakeholder input to improve service quality and access. Develop standard procedures, training materials, work aids, dashboards, and business cases that support responsible growth, funding, and sustainability.

Administration and Leadership —

Planning and reporting: Develop annual work plans, schedules, communication plans, metrics, and resource projections. Prepare concise reports and presentations for Cancer Service Line and Massey leadership, investigators, funders, and community partners.
Operational coordination: Facilitate meetings, clarify roles, coordinate assignments, and maintain productive relationships across participating units. Recommend process improvements and implement approved policy, workflow, or technology changes.
Training and functional leadership: Train staff, trainees, and collaborators in study procedures and tobacco-treatment workflows. Provide functional direction to assigned personnel; formal supervisory duties, if any, will follow the approved HR classification and organizational structure.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Doctoral degree in epidemiology, public health, population health, behavioral science, health services research, nursing science, a closely related discipline or an equivalent combination of training & experience.
At least three years of relevant research experience in cancer epidemiology, cancer survivorship, tobacco control, supportive oncology, population health, or a closely related area
Current Tobacco Treatment Specialist certification or documented ability to complete an approved certification within six months of appointment.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement research protocols, prepare IRB materials, manage study timelines and data, analyze results, and contribute to peer-reviewed dissemination.
Experience with quantitative epidemiologic methods and statistical programming using one or more platforms such as SAS, R, Stata, Python, SQL, SPSS, or an equivalent tool.
Experience working with one or more complex health-data sources, such as electronic health records, cancer registries, surveillance systems, administrative claims, clinical research data, surveys, or census-based datasets.
Demonstrated expertise or applied experience in tobacco cessation, tobacco-control research, behavioral intervention delivery, or implementation of evidence-informed health programs.
Ability and willingness to facilitate a minimum of one smoking-cessation group session each week, including occasional schedule flexibility needed to meet participant and community needs.
Strong scientific writing, presentation, group-facilitation, interpersonal, project-management, and time-management skills.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with investigators, clinicians, administrators, trainees, patients, and community partners and to foster an environment of respect, professionalism, and civility among people with varied backgrounds and experiences.
Research or program experience in an NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center, academic medical center, oncology practice, or cancer survivorship program.
Demonstrated record of peer-reviewed publications in cancer survivorship, tobacco cessation, cancer epidemiology, health disparities, supportive oncology, or related fields.
Experience conducting systematic reviews or meta-analyses and applying advanced methods such as causal inference, multilevel modeling, survival analysis, data mining, or predictive modeling.
Experience contributing methods, analysis plans, power calculations, or evaluation components to externally funded grants and community-engaged research initiatives.
Experience teaching, mentoring, or translating complex epidemiologic evidence for clinical, community, student, or executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to work in and foster an environment of respect, professionalism and civility with a population of faculty, staff, and students from all backgrounds and experiences, or a commitment to do so as a staff member at VCU.

Preferred Qualifications

Clinical or health-professions training that supports effective collaboration with oncology care teams, while recognizing that this role does not independently practice outside the individual’s license or institutional privileges.
Experience developing dashboards or visualizations and implementing reproducible data-management and analytic workflows

About Tapestry

Tapestry is a group within Google working to build the AI-powered electric grid. We are tackling one of the world’s most important infrastructure challenges: helping the energy system become more visible, understandable, reliable, affordable, abundant, and clean.

Originally born at X, Alphabet’s moonshot factory, Tapestry brings together experts in energy, AI, software engineering, and products to build tools that help the electricity ecosystem plan smarter, move faster, and operate more efficiently.

This is a global effort. Tapestry supports partners across the U.S., U.K., Chile, New Zealand, Australia, and Brazil as they work toward a cleaner, more resilient energy future.

Joining Tapestry means doing high-impact work with a multidisciplinary team tackling a problem that matters at global scale. Learn more about our team and our mission here.

About The Role

Tapestry is looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the execution and efficiency of how our Software Engineering, Product, Power System Experts, and cross functional teams work together in preparing our product development and commercialization.

This role will support the day-to-day progress of our software development, align both internal and external product priorities, and proactively identify and solve problems to guide the team through the dynamic phases of product development.. This is an incredibly dynamic role and requires high cross-functional communication, organization, and planning. They are accountable for the successful implementation of TPM processes, tracking progress against product and project goals, and driving velocity, efficiency, and teamwork without burning out stakeholders. You will work across AI, energy systems, and product teams to deliver foundational capabilities for the mission.

How You Will Make 10X Impact

Program Leadership and Strategic Execution
Drive Velocity and Teamwork: Foster a high-performance culture that balances workload, optimizes engineering sprints, and maximizes team efficiency and collaboration.
Goal Setting and Tracking: Partner with leadership to establish clear project goals, map out workstreams, and carefully track progress against a "high-bar" delivery plan.
Milestone Ownership: Manage internal operations and cross-functional coordination to ensure the team consistently hits product release schedules and critical milestones.
Translate Customer Impact: Deeply understand customer and commercial priorities, translating them into engineering impact to provide realistic input on timelines and technical feasibility.

Process, Alignment and Ownership
Agile Facilitation: Lead and optimize core agile ceremonies; facilitate stand-ups, retrospectives, and cross-functional syncs to ensure continuous alignment.
Sprint Planning and Backlog Management: Lead sprint planning sessions, structure meetings, and organize bugs/feature requests into a prioritized product backlog.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Engineering, Product and PSE teams to align with product and project priorities and remove blockers.
Process Implementation: Responsible for the successful implementation of TPM processes within Tapestry’s cross-functional teams.

Risk Mitigation and Navigating Ambiguity
Risk Mitigation: Identify and escalate risks early, drive decision-making, and ensure the team remains focused on the highest-priority development tasks.
Proactive Problem Solving: Proactively identify operational bottlenecks and create programs and processes to solve them.
Ambiguity Resolution: In the absence of a clear path, the TPM must deal with ambiguity by creating the path, defining the resource map, and setting the strategy to address the challenge.
Stakeholder Expectation Management: Guide the team through the learning and changes inherent in early product development, ensuring stakeholders have visibility into progress and potential shifts.

What You Should Have…

At least 5 years of project/program management or product development experience.
Experience driving a program from prototype to maturity at an enterprise scale.
Communicate with clarity and purpose, especially when navigating technical or strategic ambiguity.
Track record of successful implementation of TPM processes in engineering organizations.
Navigate complexity with calm, structured reasoning and a focus on radical simplification.
Hold a high bar for craftsmanship and care deeply about the quality of your work.
Enjoy collaborating with experts across disciplines to drive towards a shared mission.
Feel motivated by real-world impact and the opportunity to build something transformative.

It’d be great if you also had one or more of these:

Masters degree in engineering disciplines, or equivalent practical experience
Experience working on, or passion for, the energy sector or sustainability
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, working with technical and cross-functional teams who do not report into this role to get things done
Track record of delivering scalable solutions to complex software problems
Experience in startup or high-growth environments

Tapestry Values

Take charge: We take initiative and own outcomes that move the mission forward.
Transform with purpose: We build solutions that solve real problems and create meaningful impact.
Be a Tapestry, not a thread: We collaborate across diverse skills and perspectives to achieve more than we can individually.
Always fine-tune: We stay curious, seek feedback, and refine our understanding as we learn.
Stay grounded: We listen openly, value different perspectives, and stay focused on what matters most.

However, there is a very strong preference for someone that can work a hybrid schedule and go into the New York, Boston, Wayne, Parsippany, or Durham locations several days per week. This preference is due to supporting global teams in different time zones.

About The Team

IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science contributes to advancing human health by generating rigorous, evidence-based research. IQVIA Institute utilizes proprietary data sources, subject matter experts, advanced analytical skills, academic and external partners to conduct research and develop objective and data driven reports. These reports are intended for a broad set of stakeholders across the health system, such as policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc. Our reports are widely downloaded with nearly 70,000 downloads last year along with over 600 citations in scholarly publications. Research at the IQVIA Institute can vary in size and complexity. We apply quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to a a variety of IQVIA data sources, external data sources and secondary literature to develop our reports. IQVIA Institute provides an opportunity to engage with crucial public health and public policy topics that can improve patient lives across the globe and to interact with key opinion leaders and stakeholders in these spaces. You'll enjoy a rewarding career in a collaborative, multicultural environment that values growth and development.

Role Overview

Project Managers are an integral part of funded research projects.

They are responsible for the on-time completion of projects or components of large, complex projects for clients in the life sciences field related to funded reports and research. They also identify and elevate potential new business opportunities and assists in the sales process. Their projects range in complexity from basic analysis and problem solving to assisting in the development of more complex solutions. PM's serve as project leaders and manage the client relationship associated with specific projects. These projects may be done in partnership with several other teams across IQVIA. The research and reports led by the senior consultant contribute to public health and public policy discourse across the globe and are well respected and used by stakeholders across the healthcare system (from policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc.)

Participate or lead teams in the design, development and delivery of funded research projects or components of larger, complex projects.

Provide direction and guidance to Analysts, Consultants, and where relevant, to Statistical Services assigned to engagement.
Develop detailed documentation and specifications.
Perform qualitative and/or quantitative analyses to assist in the development of tailored funded research solutions.
Design, structure and deliver reports and presentations that are appropriate to the characteristics or needs of the audience.
Recommend improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems.
Identify potential new business opportunities of follow-on work and new leads at assigned client.
Provide follow-up with client after project deliverable has been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
Proactively develop broader and deeper knowledge of methodologies and life sciences industry, healthcare policy globally through on the job experience and participation in training opportunities. Begin to develop subject matter expertise across healthcare system topics
When acting as Project Manager, proactively manage project timelines and manage day to day communication with the client and team members.

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, public health or other related field required. MBA, MPH, PhD with a life sciences or healthcare focus preferred.
Typically possesses 5-8 years of post-undergraduate experience or 3-5 years of post Masters experience.
Possesses solid project management skills and client management and relationship building skills.
Experienced with developing consultative relationships with senior level managers and executives at clients in the life science industry.
Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
Knowledge of consulting and research methodologies, tools and techniques related to functional area.

Results oriented approach to work delivery and output. Ability to solve problems independently and creatively.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.
You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.
What We’re Looking For

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

The Revenue & Sales Operations team at Consensus is the high-impact team that drives global Sales Strategy, Analytics, Sales Planning, Learning & Development, Commercial Management, the Sales Tech Stack and Sales Operations for all revenue driving teams.

Within Revenue and Sales Operations, this individual will focus directly on leading our Customer Retention program and efforts globally. Develop, launch and manage programs and efforts to address Customer Retention and prevent churn.
Monitor the effectiveness of these Retention programs and iterate as needed
Partner closely with Product, Sales, CS, Lifecycle Marketing, Contract Management, and Renewal Teams to align business objectives with data analysis and relay critical insights (e.g., feeding churn accelerator data back to the Product team).
Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reports for Senior leaders.
Frequently present findings to senior audiences including our CEO, CRO, and SVPs.
Create dashboards and visualizations to communicate insights to relevant business
Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

5+ years experience in Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Analytics, Data Analytics, or Consulting.

2+ years of experience in SAAS environments
2+ years using SQL/SOQL for joining subscription, billing, product-usage, support, CRM, marketing, and customer-success data.
2+ years using Python or R for data cleaning, feature engineering, statistical analysis, automation, and model development. Python experience with pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM.

Deep knowledge of AI is a key requirement. You must have hands-on experience utilizing tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI, and other similar AI platforms to drive automation, advanced analytics, and operational efficiency.
Strong ability to navigate in ambiguous environments; projects may start very ambiguously and with little direction; you will need strong Project Planning skills to scope and plan a project from start to finish.

Ability to successfully work independently ensuring prompt completion of projects.
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Experience presenting data to a variety of audiences in a manner that tells a story.

Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. You will work directly with internal and external engineers, customers, subcontractors, and utilities, and must be able to successfully manage communications with a wide variety of stakeholders and audiences.

What You'll Do

Own the schedule, budget, and overall success of multiple concurrent energy project deployments at varying lifecycle stages

Read electrical single-line diagrams and translate them into real constructability discussions with engineers, contractors, AHJs and inspectors.

Spot opportunities to automate reporting, tracking, and other repetitive PM work, and prototype lightweight scripts or tools to do it

Excellent communication abilities, both written and verbal, to a wide variety of audiences
Experience delivering complex projects on time and within budget
Background in commercial energy, infrastructure, or construction
Comfortable working with numbers day to day, tracking budget/schedule variance in a spreadsheet or PM tool and translating it into a clear customer or leadership update

Experience creating and managing a Gantt-style schedule with dependency logic, paired with the judgment to adapt the plan in real time when field conditions change

jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

Zipline is looking for a Technical Program Manager, Facilities to deliver the spaces and infrastructure that support our engineering, test, manufacturing, and workplace teams. You will lead facilities projects from initial requirements and feasibility through design, permitting, construction, commissioning, and operational handoff, with accountability for scope, budget, schedule, and readiness for use.

Working closely with Facilities, engineering stakeholders, EHS, IT, and external partners, you will translate evolving business needs into executable project plans. Your work will include new facilities, renovations, equipment installations, utility upgrades, and relocations, coordinating the building systems and operational dependencies required to bring each space into service.

We are looking for someone who combines technical judgment with hands-on program execution. You ask why a requirement exists, challenge assumptions with evidence, and find practical ways to meet competing needs. You can create clarity from incomplete information, hold partners accountable, and deliver projects in active environments where safety and operational continuity matter.

What You'll Do

Lead a portfolio of facilities capital projects, establishing scope, success criteria, budgets, schedules, and accountable owners from project initiation through handoff.
Partner with internal teams to define space, equipment, utility, and operational requirements. Separate essential needs from preferences and turn them into clear project scopes.
Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, and specialty vendors through design, permitting, procurement, and construction. Set deliverables and resolve gaps between disciplines and project packages.
Use technical judgment to evaluate building-system capacity, equipment requirements, constructability, and maintainability. Challenge unnecessary scope and develop alternatives that improve cost or schedule while meeting safety and performance requirements.
Build integrated project schedules that account for permits, long-lead equipment, utility connections, shutdowns, and occupancy requirements. Identify critical dependencies and drive timely decisions.
Develop requests for proposals and evaluate bids with Procurement and project partners. Track commitments, forecasts, and change orders, and make clear recommendations on scope and spending decisions.
Coordinate site work, equipment installations, relocations, and shutdowns with Facilities, EHS, IT, and operating teams to protect safety and minimize disruption.
Maintain clear reporting on milestones, budgets, risks, and decisions. Escalate issues with a recommended path forward and drive recovery plans when delivery is at risk.
Lead readiness reviews and coordinate commissioning, inspections, punch-list completion, and handoff. Ensure Facilities and end users receive the documentation, training, and maintenance information needed to operate the space.

What You'll Bring

A track record of managing complex facilities, infrastructure, or construction programs from initial scope through operational handoff, with accountability for budget, schedule, and quality.
A technical foundation in mechanical, electrical, structural, architectural, or facilities engineering, construction management, or a related discipline, gained through education or equivalent practical experience.
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders, including work in active manufacturing, laboratory, R&D, or other technical environments.
The ability to read technical drawings, assess building-system and equipment dependencies, and ask the questions needed to identify design or execution risks. Working knowledge of permitting, construction sequencing, and commissioning.
Strong program management skills, including scope development, estimating, scheduling, bid evaluation, change management, and risk resolution across multiple concurrent projects.
Clear communication and sound judgment when priorities compete. The ability to explain technical trade-offs, recommend a path forward, and influence teams without direct authority.
A hands-on approach to execution, curiosity about how facilities support the business, and ownership of problems through resolution.

What Else You Need To Know

The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement, consistently identifying opportunities for process enhancements within cloud infrastructure operations..

Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).

BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

In-depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up, combined with deep familiarity with cloud-native product and services environments.
Working knowledge of cloud technologies including Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, and related tooling.
Familiarity with AI and ML infrastructure, with an understanding of how NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms are applied across academic, startup, and enterprise environments.
Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation, with a keen eye for identifying and driving process improvement opportunities.
A highly enthusiastic, energetic, responsive, and passionate individual who thrives in fast-paced environments and is driven to deliver meaningful value to DGX Cloud customers.

This opportunity has the potential to be remote for a strong candidate that is not located near an east coast office. This preference is due to supporting global teams in different time zones.

About The Team

IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science contributes to advancing human health by generating rigorous, evidence-based research. IQVIA Institute utilizes proprietary data sources, subject matter experts, advanced analytical skills, academic and external partners to conduct research and develop objective and data driven reports. These reports are intended for a broad set of stakeholders across the health system, such as policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc. Our reports are widely downloaded with nearly 70,000 downloads last year along with over 600 citations in scholarly publications. Research at the IQVIA Institute can vary in size and complexity. We apply quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to a a variety of IQVIA data sources, external data sources and secondary literature to develop our reports. IQVIA Institute provides an opportunity to engage with crucial public health and public policy topics that can improve patient lives across the globe and to interact with key opinion leaders and stakeholders in these spaces. You'll enjoy a rewarding career in a collaborative, multicultural environment that values growth and development.

Role Overview

Project Managers are an integral part of funded research projects.

They are responsible for the on-time completion of projects or components of large, complex projects for clients in the life sciences field related to funded reports and research. They also identify and elevate potential new business opportunities and assists in the sales process. Their projects range in complexity from basic analysis and problem solving to assisting in the development of more complex solutions. PM's serve as project leaders and manage the client relationship associated with specific projects. These projects may be done in partnership with several other teams across IQVIA. The research and reports led by the senior consultant contribute to public health and public policy discourse across the globe and are well respected and used by stakeholders across the healthcare system (from policy makers, physicians, patients, societies, foundations etc.)

Essential Functions

Participate or lead teams in the design, development and delivery of funded research projects or components of larger, complex projects.
Review and analyze client requirements or problems and assist in the development of proposals of cost effective solutions that ensure profitability and high client satisfaction while meeting IQVIA Institute standards
Provide direction and guidance to Analysts, Consultants, and where relevant, to Statistical Services assigned to engagement.
Develop detailed documentation and specifications.
Perform qualitative and/or quantitative analyses to assist in the development of tailored funded research solutions.
Design, structure and deliver reports and presentations that are appropriate to the characteristics or needs of the audience.
Recommend improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems.

new_jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, CX Operations & Programs
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Experience (CX) Operations & Programs team, you’ll lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and turn customer insight into action. You’ll bring structure to complex priorities, improve how teams plan and execute, and help connect customer feedback to better experiences, product decisions, adoption, retention, and advocacy—advancing 1Password’s mission through meaningful customer impact. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Operations & Programs, this role is remote in Canada or the United States, with a preference for Eastern Time.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What We're Looking For

6+ years of experience in program management, operations, strategy and operations, or a related field, including work on customer-focused programs.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial scope through implementation, adoption, and transition to ongoing ownership.
Ability to create structure from ambiguity, right-size processes, manage competing priorities, and move work forward with sound judgment.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience influencing partners without formal authority and aligning teams with different priorities, working styles, and levels of technical knowledge.
Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools and automation to improve research, analysis, planning, communication, workflow execution, or operational efficiency.
Preferred: Experience in Customer Success, customer engagement, Voice of Customer, customer advocacy, customer insights, customer content, digital engagement, or customer education. Familiarity with tools such as Asana or Notion, or a project management certification, is also helpful.

What You Can Expect

Lead strategic programs across customer engagement, including Voice of Customer, customer content, advocacy, and related initiatives.
Establish clear plans, owners, milestones, dependencies, success measures, and operating rhythms that improve visibility and execution.
Build scalable ways to collect, synthesize, and activate customer feedback, connecting insights to decisions, communications, and measurable improvements.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer journeys, handoffs, feedback loops, and other important moments across the customer lifecycle.
Partner with Customer Experience, Go To Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and other teams to manage tradeoffs and deliver shared outcomes.
Present concise, recommendation-led updates in team meetings, company forums, and executive discussions.
Support rollout, communications, enablement, and adoption for new programs, processes, tools, and ways of working, while identifying opportunities for simplification and automation.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $131,000 USD and $190,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $110,000 CAD and $160,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

Description

Field has entered its next phase of growth. In June, the UK energy regulator, Ofgem, selected 16 long-duration energy storage projects to progress to delivery. Field were awarded 5 of these. Collectively, in MWh terms, our projects are approximately 3 times the capacity of all battery energy storage installed in the UK to date. We currently have 4 projects totalling over 1GWh of energy storage in construction in GB with lots more delivery to do.

Your Mission

As Assistant Project Manager at Field you will support some of the world’s longest duration BESS projects through pre-construction, final-investment decision (FID), construction, commissioning and handover to Operations.

The role requires active management of your projects under the direction of the Project Manager, you therefore need to be highly engaged, resilient, execution-focused and detail-oriented. You’ll need to be passionate about project management fundamentals (e.g. programme, budget, quality) and have proven stakeholder management and communication skills.

You will report to the Head of Delivery (Michael) and work closely with in-house experts across Engineering, QHSE, Procurement, Legal and Development. Day-to-day you will work alongside more senior Project Managers as part of a core project team, driving projects through pre-construction and construction.

This is a role for aspiring project managers to take more responsibility and gain hands-on project management experience. There will be great opportunities for career progression and we are seeking candidates who want to progress into more senior roles.

Key Responsibilities

What You’ll Be Doing

This is a broad and varied role with the opportunity to have massive impact. Key responsibilities including

Support the Project Managers (PM) through the pre-construction phase of the project (following end of the planning & development phase, or following the acquisition of a RTB Asset)
Assisting PMs with general day to day activities, with opportunities to take management responsibilities for some packages of work.
Coordinate and support an internal project team in the run-up to Final Investment Decision (FID), with a sharp focus on programme
Support planning discharge activities with the development team and engagement with landowners to ensure land-related obligations are met
Support PM’s to manage the performance of services carried out by consultants we appoint to support on the execution of the projects such as Technical Advisors, Health and Safety, and Environmental.
Manage, update and interpret and the pre-construction risk register, the master project-schedule, project-budget and action tracker (what we call the “basics” from which all activities are prioritised)

Support the PM to manage the construction phase to safely meet agreed time, quality and budget targets
Lead by example and ensure our health & safety culture is adopted on all projects
Manage our construction contracts, including the BESS supplier, BoP contractor, TO, grid-compliance and any other packages of work required for the project
Help deliver all “Client” responsibilities noted within the employer’s requirements and interface matrix of construction contracts. This includes managing variations to planning, meeting our lease commitments and sourcing free-issue equipment and services (e.g. fibre, fiscal metres, RTM provider)
Support the by ensuring key project management documents are prepared to an excellent standard in line with the business reporting calendar

Ensure the project seamlessly enters commercial operation & close-out contracts
Coordinate with our commercial operations team and asset managers on revenue readiness activities
Have a clear understanding on how our construction schedules impact on revenue streams (e.g. Capacity Market milestone dates)
Agree (and manage the close-out) of construction defects and settle final accounts with support of the contract manager

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The Skills You’ll Need

Engineering, construction, science, commercial or project-management background. Ideally with minimum 3 years of experience (relevant graduate schemes will also be considered)
Experience on energy infrastructure projects is a bonus (batteries, onshore or offshore wind, solar, peaking plants, interconnectors/HVDC, thermal power generation)
You’re an open, clear communicator (written and verbal) who enjoys working collaboratively
You love Gantt charts, risk registers and attending site!
You have a curious mind and pride yourself on always learning, adapting and improving
You’re known as a problem solver, someone who enjoys bringing order to chaos and taking quick action to move things forward
You’re known for your personal integrity - you don’t cut corners and you’re quick to acknowledge and learn from your mistakes
You have a growth mindset and a humble outlook - you share openly, both the good and the bad
You’re enthusiastic about project management and its application in the delivery of green energy projects

Benefits

Package Details

Salary: DOE

We’re offering a competitive compensation package, including participation in our employee share scheme which rewards all employees for the growth of the business. You’ll be awarded shares when you join, which will vest over four years - and as the business grows in size and value, so will your shares!

We value our team’s wellbeing and belonging so we invest approx £5,000 a year on a range of perks, benefits and wellbeing activities, including regular team socials and events.

Other Benefits Include

Up to 10% Company wide bonus based on company performance
Hybrid working (blend of home and office working to suit individual needs)
£2,000 per year to spend on your professional development
Private medical cover with Bupa from day one with the option to add family members.
Company Pension with 8% Contribution
Enhanced parental leave, for all new parents:
6 months fully paid primary carer leave
3 months fully paid secondary carer leave
10 days fully paid leave for fertility treatment

Fun co-working office space in Shoreditch, London
1 month work from anywhere, for those with a travel bug
1 day green leave to do something good for the environment
free lunch once a week - a great way to get to know people in the wider team
dog friendly office, feel free to bring your pooch along
Spill: our mental health benefit allowing every Fielder access to equal and unrestricted therapy and resources
Regular, optional team socials designed to be inclusive for everyone (not just the pub goers!)
Birthday carbon offset: a gift from Field to the world to celebrate your birthday

A Bit About Field

Field is an international builder, owner, and operator of renewable infrastructure. Founded by a successful entrepreneur, we have robust BESS project pipelines across the UK, Italy, Spain, and Germany, backed by a recent £200 million investment from DIF Capital Partners. Our mission is to grow internationally and develop a strong global BESS portfolio.

We are an eclectic team with diverse backgrounds, from scaling billion-dollar tech startups to building energy companies and specializing in energy markets. You'll work with fun, curious, entrepreneurial people making a real impact. We're proving batteries are a viable energy solution now. Our ambitious plans include becoming Europe's leading clean energy player and expanding beyond batteries into new assets.

Our Values

Work for the team - We are friendly and approachable. We make time for each other, value diverse perspectives, and learn and grow together.
Do it right - We prioritise doing things right, never cutting corners. Safety comes first, and we consider our impact on communities and the environment. We act with integrity always.
Move fast - We’re doers. We take responsibility, deliver on promises, and get things done. FAST.
Know your stuff - We’re curious self-starters, always learning, adapting, and improving. No question is too small. We own our growth.

Read more about our values at www.field.energy

Love the sound of Field but not sure this role is right for you? Have a look at our careers page and register your CV. We are always interested in candidates who have exposure to BESS and work within the Renewable Energy space. We’d love to hear from you

Equality, Diversity & inclusion

Diverse teams make better teams. Field is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment which is as representative as possible of our society. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender expression, marriage/civil partnership status, pregnancy/maternity status, race, nationality, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. new_jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, CX Operations & Programs
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Experience (CX) Operations & Programs team, you’ll lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and turn customer insight into action. You’ll bring structure to complex priorities, improve how teams plan and execute, and help connect customer feedback to better experiences, product decisions, adoption, retention, and advocacy—advancing 1Password’s mission through meaningful customer impact. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Operations & Programs, this role is remote in Canada or the United States, with a preference for Eastern Time.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What We're Looking For

6+ years of experience in program management, operations, strategy and operations, or a related field, including work on customer-focused programs.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial scope through implementation, adoption, and transition to ongoing ownership.
Ability to create structure from ambiguity, right-size processes, manage competing priorities, and move work forward with sound judgment.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience influencing partners without formal authority and aligning teams with different priorities, working styles, and levels of technical knowledge.
Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools and automation to improve research, analysis, planning, communication, workflow execution, or operational efficiency.
Preferred: Experience in Customer Success, customer engagement, Voice of Customer, customer advocacy, customer insights, customer content, digital engagement, or customer education. Familiarity with tools such as Asana or Notion, or a project management certification, is also helpful.

What You Can Expect

Lead strategic programs across customer engagement, including Voice of Customer, customer content, advocacy, and related initiatives.
Establish clear plans, owners, milestones, dependencies, success measures, and operating rhythms that improve visibility and execution.
Build scalable ways to collect, synthesize, and activate customer feedback, connecting insights to decisions, communications, and measurable improvements.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer journeys, handoffs, feedback loops, and other important moments across the customer lifecycle.
Partner with Customer Experience, Go To Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and other teams to manage tradeoffs and deliver shared outcomes.
Present concise, recommendation-led updates in team meetings, company forums, and executive discussions.
Support rollout, communications, enablement, and adoption for new programs, processes, tools, and ways of working, while identifying opportunities for simplification and automation.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $131,000 USD and $190,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $110,000 CAD and $160,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Als Technical Project Manager werk je op het snijvlak van klanten, technologie en operations. Je begeleidt projecten en technische implementaties, pakt klantvragen en tickets op en onderzoekt bugs of andere problemen die binnenkomen. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig, analytisch en communicatief sterk bent.

Je vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen, koppelingen en processen werken en bouwt daardoor stap voor stap steeds meer technische kennis op. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de rol is stakeholdermanagement. Je schakelt met klanten, interne collega’s en technische specialisten, bewaakt verwachtingen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat de volgende stap is. Ook wanneer iets niet volgens plan verloopt, blijf je duidelijk, professioneel en diplomatiek communiceren.

Wat ga je doen?

Klant- en operationsprojecten coördineren van start tot afronding.
Klanten begeleiden bij implementaties van koppelingen, integraties en tools.
Afstemmen met klanten en interne stakeholders over planning, voortgang en knelpunten.
Tickets, bugs en technische vragen onderzoeken en opvolgen.
Informatie verzamelen en een eerste analyse doen voordat je een issue doorzet naar een specialist.
Acties bewaken en zorgen dat vragen en problemen daadwerkelijk worden afgerond.
Kennis, oplossingen en werkwijzen documenteren en delen.
Samenwerken met ervaren Operations Specialists met verschillende expertisegebieden.

Wat zoeken we?

Je Past Goed Bij Deze Rol Als Je

sterk bent in communicatie en stakeholdermanagement;
diplomatiek kunt omgaan met verschillende belangen en verwachtingen;
nieuwsgierig bent en graag zelf dingen uitzoekt;
analytisch en gestructureerd werkt;
verantwoordelijkheid neemt en afspraken goed opvolgt;
affiniteit hebt met technologie en nieuwe systemen snel oppakt;
zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook gemakkelijk de samenwerking opzoekt;
niet schrikt van technische onderwerpen, ook als je nog niet alles begrijpt.
professioneel kunt communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Technische kennis is een plus, maar geen harde eis. We zoeken vooral iemand met de juiste houding: iemand die wil begrijpen hoe iets werkt, goede vragen stelt en zich technische onderwerpen snel eigen maakt.
